ask: can u make a poll for this
sentence: A yes or no vote on each of several proposed shared-living rules, where every member votes on each rule and anyone can add a new rule.
use_when: a group wants to agree on house or suite rules
each proposed rule needs its own yes or no from every person
members should be able to add their own rule ideas
you want to see how many people have voted on every rule
dont_use_when: you need to pick one option from a list, like a single winner
you need a time or date to be chosen for a meeting
you need to split costs or track chores over time
